reject: Tutorial or benchmark is the only reason to build
Generic model demo with no customer decision
Repository popularity used as demand evidence
Invented complaints, market size or novelty
rules: Problem evidence comes before method selection. Tutorials may support implementation only.
Separate verified pain, vendor assertions, research evidence and our product hypothesis. Record inaccessible sources honestly.
Find current competing products and counterevidence; explain why a narrow user segment might still be underserved.
Allow research-only possibilities but label them exploratory, set auto_eligible=false and never recommend for automatic building.
A weekly release tests a customer decision or risky assumption; it is not an arbitrary ML exercise.
For thesis: additionally require feasible data, meaningful baselines, research question and closest-work review.
Keep broad source/domain exploration; the current three projects are not future topic filters.
Do not fill quotas with weak ideas. Report rejected candidates and missing evidence.
